practice.prompt: A circle has radius 6 and central angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in the sector area.
A sector has radius 4 and central angle 180°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: A semicircle is half the disk: (180/360)π(4²)=8π.

practice.prompt: A 360° sector has radius 3. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: A full turn is the entire circle, so area=π(3²)=9π.

practice.prompt: A sector has radius 10 and central angle 36°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
practice.solution: The fraction is 36/360=1/10. Multiply by r²=100 to get area 10π.

practice.prompt: A radius-12 sector has area 12π square units. Find its central angle in degrees.
practice.solution: Use 12π=(θ/360)π(144). Divide by π, so 12=144θ/360; solve θ=30°.

practice.prompt: A sector has radius 9 and angle 120°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A 45° sector occupies what decimal fraction of the entire disk?
practice.solution: The area fraction equals the angle fraction: 45/360=1/8=0.125.

practice.prompt: A circular garden sector has radius 15 m and central angle 72°. Find the coefficient of π in its area in m².
Two sectors of the same circle have central angles 60° and 120°. Find the smaller-to-larger area ratio.
practice.solution: With the same radius, sector areas are proportional to central angles. The ratio is 60/120=0.5.

practice.prompt: A sector in a circle of radius 10 has area 25π. Find its central angle in degrees.
A semicircular sector has area 18π. Find its radius.
A radius-14 circle contains a sector with area 49π. What decimal fraction of the full disk is shaded?
practice.solution: The whole disk is 196π, so the shaded fraction is 49π/196π=0.25.

practice.prompt: A sector's central angle stays fixed while its radius doubles. By what factor does its area change?
practice.solution: Area is proportional to r² at fixed angle. The new-to-old ratio is (2r)²/r²=4.

practice.prompt: A sector has radius 12 and central angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in its ARC LENGTH (not area).
practice.solution: Arc length=(90/360)×2π×12=(1/4)×24π=6π. Do not use the area formula.

practice.prompt: An annular sector has outer radius 10, inner radius 6, and angle 90°. Find the coefficient of π in its area.
A radius-20 circle has a 27° sector removed. Find the coefficient of π in the remaining area.
practice.solution: The whole disk has area 400π. The removed sector is (27/360)400π=30π. Remaining area is 370π.

practice.prompt: Two adjacent sectors of the same radius-12 circle have central angles 75° and 45°. Find the coefficient of π in their COMBINED area.
practice.solution: Combine angles first: 75°+45°=120°. The area is (120/360)π(12²)=48π.

practice.prompt: An annular sector has outer radius 10, inner radius 2, and area 24π. Find its central angle in degrees.
